record.question:
According to the Census of India 2011, which of the following is a correct criteria for the designation
     of census towns?
options: 85 per cent and above of the male main working population being engaged in non-agricultural pursuits
A density of population of at least 400 persons per sq. km.
A Sex Ratio of more than 900.
